title: Invitations on Mobius: Bring Your Own Buyers and Suppliers
body_markdown:
A seller with excess parts often knows a buyer who wants them. A buyer with an open RFQ often works with a supplier who could fill it. Until now, getting that contact onto Mobius was a manual process, and once they signed up, they still had to find the right auction or RFQ on their own.


Invitations turn that into a few clicks. Your contact receives an email, signs up through a page that shows what they were invited to, and lands on that auction, listing, or RFQ with a short guided tour.


If the buyer you invite is new to Mobius, we waive our revenue share on their bids in that auction, so their full bid comes to you. We still handle shipping, inspection, escrow, and buyer support.


## **Invite a buyer to your auction or listing**


Open an auction from **My Auctions** and select **Invite a partner to bid** . Your buyer receives a link to every part in that auction. To point them to one part, use the same button on a listing's details page, where you can also invite them to the whole auction instead.


To share the link yourself, in an email you are already writing or another channel, select **Copy invite** instead of **Send Invite** .


The waiver applies whether you invited the buyer to the whole auction or to one listing in it.
